entry.title: Desktop Icon Dock 1.1.2
entry.content:
Desktop Icon Dock

Turns shortcuts, files and folders that you drag onto it into a centered macOS-style dock. The dock is an independent list, not a mirror of the desktop. A fully transparent background is used by default, showing only the icons; an optional Liquid Glass panel is available.

Example: icons arranged as a centered macOS-style dock; the hovered icon is magnified with its label shown.

Features

  • Drag to add: drag a shortcut, file or folder from the desktop, File Explorer or a shell:Desktop window onto the dock. It is inserted at the drop position; items that are already in the dock are ignored. .lnk and .url shortcuts are copied into a dock-owned folder, so deleting the original shortcut from the desktop leaves the dock item intact; files, folders and virtual items are referenced by path.
  • Drag to reorder: hold the left mouse button on an icon and drag it within the dock. Icons rearrange live and the new order is saved when you release the button.
  • Drag out to put back on the desktop: drag an item outside the dock and release it over the desktop. The icon is placed at the release point. If the item already lives on the desktop, its original icon is moved there; otherwise a shortcut is created on the desktop and the original file or folder stays where it is. For a shortcut that was copied into the dock, the original shortcut is used, so dragging it out does not create a second (2) copy. Releasing over any other window leaves the item in the dock. Items that have no filesystem location, such as the Recycle Bin, are only removed from the dock. A dock-owned shortcut copy is removed after it has been placed back. Removing the last item brings back the empty-state hint.
  • Empty state: a visible drop target is shown when the list is empty, so the dock can always receive the first item. The window is never hidden just because the list is empty.
  • macOS-style hover magnification: icons grow smoothly as the pointer approaches, with cosine falloff and neighboring icons spreading aside.
  • Transparent background (default): only the icons and a soft drop shadow are drawn, so the dock blends into the wallpaper; transparent areas of the dock window are click-through, so desktop right-click and clicks keep working.
  • Optional Liquid Glass panel: enabled by turning off "Transparent background". Blurred wallpaper backdrop, milky glass tint, specular rim and a hover glow. The backdrop is sampled from the screen above the dock and works with Wallpaper Engine and other animated wallpapers.
  • Name labels: hovering an icon shows a name pill above it; in transparent mode the pill stays at a fixed position instead of jumping while icons scale.
  • Native interaction: left click opens an item; right click opens that item's native Explorer context menu (open, send to, create shortcut, properties, delete, …).
  • Independent from the desktop: adding, removing, renaming or moving desktop icons does not change the dock. Shortcuts added to the dock are copied into its own folder, so even deleting them from the desktop does not affect the dock; files, folders and virtual items are referenced by path. The list is stored per user in Windhawk's mod storage and survives Explorer restarts.
  • Original desktop icons hidden in memory (optional): when enabled, the desktop's list view is hidden while the dock is active; no Explorer setting or registry value is changed, and the icons are shown again when the mod is unloaded. Off by default, so the desktop remains available as a drag source.
  • Icon cache with cleanup: icons are cached per item path and reused; virtual items such as the Recycle Bin refresh their icons periodically.

How it works

The dock keeps its own ordered list. It does not read or rearrange the system desktop icons.

  • Storage: the ordered list is saved as items.tsv in Windhawk's mod storage, in a subfolder named after the current user's security identifier (SID), so each Windows user keeps a separate list. Each entry is a desktop-absolute parsing name, such as a full file path or a shell GUID for virtual items, followed by the original path for copied shortcuts. Shortcut copies live in the Items subfolder of the same directory. Every add, reorder and removal is written immediately. Windhawk removes the whole storage folder when the mod is uninstalled.
  • Adding: external drags are received through an OLE drop target (IDropTarget), supporting file drops and shell item lists. The insertion position follows the pointer; .lnk and .url shortcuts are copied into the dock folder first. Duplicates are skipped by parsing name. The drop is processed after the drop has been accepted, so a slow or unreachable path does not freeze the drag source.
  • Reordering and removing: these are handled inside the dock window with mouse capture, so they also work in the transparent gaps between icons.
  • Putting items back on the desktop: releasing outside the panel over the desktop places the item at the release point; releasing over any other window snaps it back into the dock. An item whose parent folder is already the user or public desktop has its original icon repositioned through the desktop's folder view; for a copied shortcut the original shortcut path is used. Any other file or folder gets a uniquely named .lnk shortcut on the user desktop (a source .lnk or .url is copied, other items get a new shortcut). The original file is never moved or deleted, and a dock-owned shortcut copy is removed after it has been placed back. Positioning follows the system "align icons to grid" setting.
  • Empty state: the centered hint pill is drawn with a non-transparent background and is registered as part of the same drop target.
  • Layout: centered horizontally at the bottom of the primary monitor, above the taskbar; the panel widens as items are added, and icons are vertically centered at rest.
  • Maintenance: every 30 seconds, entries that failed to resolve earlier are retried and the icons of virtual items are refreshed. Items that still cannot be resolved are skipped on screen but kept in storage.
  • Performance: in transparent mode the pointer position is polled every 50 ms so hover magnification also works in the gaps between icons; idle CPU usage is negligible.

Settings

| Setting | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | Icon size | 48 | Base size in pixels at 100% DPI, scaled with system DPI (about 72 px at 150%) | | Icon spacing | 10 | Pixel gap between icons at rest | | Maximum scale (%) | 175 | Largest magnification of the hovered icon | | Effect radius | 160 | Distance in pixels over which magnification fades out from the cursor | | Neighbor spread (%) | 60 | How much neighboring icons move aside while magnifying | | Smoothing speed | 16 | Higher is snappier, lower is softer | | Bottom offset | 10 | Gap between the dock and the taskbar, in pixels at 100% DPI | | Transparent background | On | Show only the icons; turn off to use the Liquid Glass panel | | Glass opacity (%) | 24 | Glass mode only: strength of the milky tint | | Glass blur | 20 | Glass mode only: backdrop blur strength | | Show labels | On | Show a name pill for the hovered item | | Hide original desktop icons | Off | Hide the system desktop icons while the dock is active by hiding the desktop list view in memory; they are shown again when the mod is unloaded | | Backdrop refresh interval (s) | 20 | How often the blurred backdrop (used by the glass panel and the label pill) is re-sampled; 0 disables refresh |

How it differs from existing mods

This mod overlaps with Quick Launch Dock in the basic launcher behavior: drag in, reorder, click to launch, a persistent list. It exists separately because it targets a different use case: a dock that is part of the desktop, not a launcher that stays on top of other windows.

  • Desktop level: the window sits at the bottom of the Z-order, below all normal windows, and never takes focus. It is visible when the desktop is visible, like the desktop icons themselves.
  • Drag out to the desktop: items can be dragged from the dock back to the desktop, reusing the original shortcut when it is still there instead of creating a duplicate.
  • Desktop integration: hiding the system desktop icons in memory and opening the native Explorer context menu both work with the shell's desktop view from the mod's own process, without injecting into the running shell.
  • Screen-sampled glass: the backdrop and the name pills sample the screen area behind the dock, which requires a desktop-level window.

Compatibility and limitations

  • Windows 10 / 11 on x86-64 only. The mod runs as a Windhawk tool mod in a dedicated explorer.exe process, separate from the shell's own explorer.exe; the shell is only accessed through its published shell interfaces. (The windhawk.exe host cannot be used here: Windhawk is a 32-bit app, while this mod is x86-64.)
  • Primary monitor only; the dock is anchored to the bottom of the primary monitor, above the taskbar.
  • The dock is a layered window placed below normal windows; full-screen apps and other windows cover it, which is expected.
  • In transparent mode, fully transparent pixels are click-through; the icons themselves remain clickable.

Troubleshooting

  • After an Explorer restart: the dock runs in its own dedicated explorer.exe process, so a shell restart does not unload it; it reconnects to the new desktop view and reapplies the icon hiding.
  • An item disappeared: its stored parsing name could not be resolved (for example, the referenced file or folder was deleted or renamed). Shortcuts are copied into the dock folder and are not affected by deleting the desktop shortcut. The entry is kept in storage and retried; it reappears if the path is available again.
  • After dragging an item out, a shortcut appeared on the desktop: this is expected. Items that are not on the desktop are not moved; a shortcut is created at the release point instead. The original file or folder is not affected, and the shortcut can be deleted at any time.
  • Settings changes seem to have no effect: saving settings reloads and rebuilds the dock automatically; no Explorer restart is needed.
  • Add an item: drag it from the desktop or any File Explorer window onto the dock. You can also press Win+R and enter shell:Desktop to open a desktop folder and drag from there.
  • Reset the list: drag the items out, or uninstall the mod. Windhawk deletes the mod's storage, including the list and the shortcut copies, when the mod is removed.

中文说明

本模组把快捷方式、文件和文件夹变成一个居中的 macOS 风格 Dock，默认使用全透明背景；关闭“透明背景”后会显示液态玻璃面板。

  • 从桌面、资源管理器或 shell:Desktop 窗口把项目拖到 Dock 上即可添加，落点决定插入位置，重复项目会被忽略。快捷方式（.lnk / .url）会复制到 Dock 自己的目录，删除桌面上的原快捷方式不影响 Dock；文件和文件夹按路径引用。
  • 按住图标在 Dock 内拖动可实时排序；拖到 Dock 外、在桌面上松手会把项目放回桌面，图标落在松手位置。项目原本就在桌面上时移动原图标；否则在桌面新建指向它的快捷方式，原文件或文件夹保持原位；对于复制进来的快捷方式会优先使用原快捷方式，不会产生多余的 (2) 副本；在其他窗口上松手则项目留在 Dock。回收站等虚拟项目仅从 Dock 移除；Dock 副本在放回桌面后删除。移除最后一项后显示空状态提示。
  • Dock 是独立列表，不同步桌面；列表保存在 Windhawk 模组存储的 items.tsv 中，并按当前用户 SID 分目录，顺序即显示顺序，重启 Explorer 后保持；快捷方式副本位于同一目录的 Items 子目录。卸载模组时 Windhawk 会删除整个存储目录。
  • 图标支持悬停放大、相邻图标让位和名称标签；左键打开，右键打开资源管理器原生菜单。
  • “隐藏原始桌面图标”默认关闭；开启后仅在内存中隐藏桌面列表视图，卸载模组后自动恢复。
  • 解析失败的项目会跳过显示但保留在存储中，每 30 秒只重试此前失败的项目；回收站等虚拟项目的图标会定期刷新。
  • 与 Quick Launch Dock 等启动器 Dock 的区别：本模组位于桌面层级（所有普通窗口之下）、不抢焦点，支持把项目拖回桌面并复用原快捷方式，还提供隐藏系统桌面图标和屏幕采样玻璃背景；这些行为通过 Shell 桌面视图完成，模组本身运行在独立的 explorer.exe tool-mod 进程中，与正在运行的 Shell 进程分离（Windhawk 主程序为 32 位，无法承载本 x86-64 模组）。
  • 仅支持 x86-64 的 Windows 10/11，且只在主显示器底部显示。

各设置项的说明见上方英文表格。

entry.title: Background Dimmer 1.0.0
entry.content:
Background Dimmer

Dims inactive windows so the active one stands out, while the background stays readable. Especially useful when working with windows side by side.

The dimming layer can be a solid tint, checkerboard, horizontal, vertical or diagonal stripes, or a tiled image of your choice. Opacity, brightness, contrast, pattern size and base color are all adjustable.

Windows that run as administrator need Windhawk 2 (currently in alpha). On Windhawk 1.x the layer can't move behind them, so when one of them gets focus, the previously active window stays undimmed.

Live configuration

The look is tuned in the mod's own configuration window, where every change shows up immediately on screen. Open it with the configuration hotkey (Win+Ctrl+Alt+D by default, changeable in the mod settings).

The window also opens by itself the first time the mod runs. If the configuration hotkey is empty or already taken by another program, it opens whenever the mod settings are saved. When it opens this way, without a keypress, Windows may keep it behind other windows: look for its flashing taskbar button.

Changes made in the configuration window are saved automatically. Dimming can be turned off with the Active checkbox in the window, or with an optional on/off hotkey.

How the controls work

  • Opacity: how strongly the layer covers the background.
  • Brightness: the overall lightness of the layer.
  • Contrast: the difference between the light and dark parts of a pattern. At 0 the pattern disappears into a flat tint.
  • Size: the size of the checkerboard squares or the width of the stripes, in pixels.
  • Base color: tints the layer. White gives neutral gray tones.

Brightness and contrast set the two pattern tones as brightness ± contrast / 2, so one controls how dark the layer is and the other how visible the pattern is. Near the ends of the range a tone is clipped to black or white, which keeps the pattern visible over a black base, as in the default look.

Behavior

  • Dialogs stay lit together with the window that owns them.
  • The taskbar, Start, Alt+Tab and menus never move the layer.
  • When the desktop has focus, the layer can either hide or cover everything (option in the configuration window).
  • The mod runs in its own Windhawk process and does not inject into Explorer or any other program.
  • Optionally, the layer can be left out of screenshots, recordings and screen sharing while it stays visible on your screen (Windows 10 version 2004 or later).
  • The appearance is stored per computer, so all Windows users of the same PC share it.

entry.title: Explorer Tab Router 1.1.1
entry.content:
Explorer Tab Router / 资源管理器页签路由

English

Explorer Tab Router keeps ordinary folder-opening requests together in Windows 11 File Explorer while preserving explicit requests for a separate window.

Behavior

  • Open a folder externally: reuse and activate an existing tab for that folder. If the folder is not open, route the new folder window into a tab in an existing Explorer window.
  • Show a file in its folder: activate the matching folder tab and preserve the requested file selection.
  • Open in new tab from a folder context menu: create a new tab and switch to it automatically, including when that folder already has another tab. Middle-click, background tab creation, and restored tabs keep their native activation behavior.
  • Open in new window: keep the explicitly requested window separate.
  • Hold Shift while opening a folder: bypass ordinary window-to-tab routing and keep a separate window.

Enable the mod in Windhawk, then use File Explorer and other applications normally. Folder routing and tab activation do not require a separate application list. Control Panel and unsupported shell locations are allowed to remain in their own windows.

Settings

Window routing, matching-tab reuse during routing, folder-menu new-tab activation, and ShellWindows lookup activation can be enabled independently. All four are enabled by default.

The lookup compatibility option is needed by some external folder-opening and file-reveal requests. The ShellWindows query interface does not say whether a caller intends to open a folder or only inspect it. With this option enabled, a successful read-only query can also switch tabs. Disable it if query-triggered activation is undesirable; some external requests will then no longer switch an existing tab. Delayed lookup activation is canceled if the user switches to another foreground window or selects a different tab before it runs.

Source and conflicting mods

This mod builds on the routing approach introduced by Explorer Single Window Tabs by ALMAS CP. It adds existing-tab reuse and activation, file-selection preservation, explicit-window handling, automatic new-tab activation, and managed presentation recovery.

Do not enable Explorer Single Window Tabs and Explorer Tab Router together. Disable the other routing mod first.

Compatibility and limitations

Windows 11 x64 with native File Explorer tabs is required. This mod uses internal shell symbols, which are checked when it loads. A future Windows update can require a compatibility update.

For routing between Explorer processes, use windows on the same desktop and at the same privilege level. Mixing ordinary and elevated Explorer windows is outside the supported configuration.

Ctrl+N and dragging a tab into a separate window can create frames without the explicit folder-menu intent this mod recognizes. Those frames may be routed back into tabs. Disable window routing when you need to retain them as separate windows.

Some requests are handled through a temporary transparent Explorer window before routing completes. This is not a guarantee of entirely window-free navigation. If a request cannot be completed safely, the temporary window is restored instead of discarding the request. Window presentation state, including existing layered transparency, is restored on recovery.

Tab activation uses verified position hints where available. A first activation or a tab reorder can still require intermediate tab switches. Activation has an overall time limit; a routing failure restores the original window. Navigation completion uses browser events with bounded direct-view checks for providers that omit events.

The mod is distributed under the MIT license.

简体中文

资源管理器页签路由将普通的文件夹打开请求集中到 Windows 11 资源管理器页签中，同时保留明确要求打开独立窗口的操作。

使用行为

  • 从外部应用打开文件夹： 已有相同目录页签时，复用并切换过去；尚未打开时，将新目录窗口转入现有资源管理器的页签。
  • 在文件夹中显示文件： 切换到对应目录页签，并保留目标文件的选中状态。
  • 文件夹右键菜单中的“在新标签页中打开”： 新建页签并自动切换，即使相同目录已有其他页签。中键、其他后台创建及启动恢复的页签保持系统原有的激活行为。
  • 在新窗口中打开： 保留明确请求的独立窗口。
  • 按住 Shift 打开文件夹： 绕过普通窗口转页签行为，保留独立窗口。

在 Windhawk 中启用后即可正常使用，不需要逐个添加应用名单。控制面板及不支持的 Shell 位置可以保持独立窗口。

设置

窗口转页签、路由时复用相同目录、文件夹菜单新页签自动激活、ShellWindows 查询命中后激活，可分别开关；默认全部启用。

查询兼容开关用于部分外部打开目录和文件定位请求。ShellWindows 查询接口不区分“打开文件夹”和“只检查是否已打开”，因此启用后，成功的纯查询也可能切换页签。若不希望查询触发切换，可关闭此项；部分外部请求也会因此不再自动切换已有页签。延迟执行查询激活前，若用户已转到其他前台窗口或切换了不同页签，会取消这次延迟激活。

来源与冲突提示

本 mod 基于 ALMAS CP 的 Explorer Single Window Tabs 路由思路扩展，增加已有页签复用与切换、文件选中保留、明确的新窗口请求识别、新页签自动激活，以及窗口状态恢复管理。

请勿同时启用 Explorer Single Window Tabs 与 Explorer Tab Router；启用前先停用另一个路由 mod。

兼容性与限制

需要 Windows 11 x64 以及支持原生页签的资源管理器。加载时会检查所需的系统内部符号，未来 Windows 更新可能需要同步更新兼容实现。

在资源管理器进程之间路由时，请使用同一桌面、相同权限级别的窗口；混用普通权限和管理员权限的资源管理器窗口不属于支持范围。

Ctrl+N 和将页签拖出为独立窗口，可能不携带本 mod 能识别的文件夹菜单意图，因此产生的窗口仍可能被合并回页签；需要保留这些独立窗口时，可关闭窗口转页签设置。

部分请求会先经过临时透明窗口，再完成页签路由，因此不保证整个过程完全不创建窗口。无法安全完成时会恢复临时窗口，避免丢弃打开请求；恢复时会还原原有窗口显示状态，包括已有的分层透明属性。

页签切换会复用经过验证的位置记录；首次切换或重新排序后仍可能短暂经过其他页签。激活设有总超时限制，路由失败时恢复原窗口。导航完成优先使用浏览器事件；缺少事件时只进行有限次直接视图检查。

本 mod 使用 MIT 许可。

entry.title: File Explorer Address Bar Home Button 1.0.3
entry.content:
File Explorer Address Bar Home Button

Adds a native WinUI 3 Home ("This PC") button directly adjacent to the Refresh button in the Windows 11 File Explorer address bar.

Features

  • Native WinUI 3 Integration: Injects an AppBarButton directly into File Explorer's address bar command bar (CommandBar#NavigationCommands) next to refreshButton.
  • Exact Visual & Theme Match: Inherits the native refreshButton's style, dimensions, margins, corner radius, and hover/pressed/focus visual states, dynamically matching Windows 11 Light, Dark, and High Contrast themes.
  • Active-Tab-Only Navigation: Uses COM Shell APIs (IShellWindows, IServiceProvider, IShellBrowser::BrowseObject, and IWebBrowser2::Navigate2) matched against the active ShellTabWindowClass child window so only the currently active tab navigates to This PC (shell:MyComputerFolder / ::{20D04FE0-3AEA-1069-A2D8-08002B30309D}).
  • Configurable Settings: Customize the target shell location, button placement (before or after the Refresh button), icon glyph (Home \uE80F or Computer \uE770), and tooltip text (This PC).
  • Clean Lifecycle: Supports live injection into open File Explorer windows (appearing immediately or on window focus), live settings updates, and clean removal on mod unload without leaking XAML elements or conflicting with other XAML mods.

entry.title: WinRAR Tweaks 1.0.0
entry.content:
WinRAR Tweaks

All-in-one quality-of-life enhancements for WinRAR that modernize navigation and file size readability without altering archive behavior.

✨ Features

  • ⌨️ Smart Close on Esc: Quickly close WinRAR with the Escape key—just like modern utilities and viewers. Intelligently respects active context menus, menu bars, dropdowns, inline file renaming, and child dialogs (closing open popups first before closing the main window).
  • 📊 Human-Readable File Sizes: Automatically converts hard-to-read raw byte counts (e.g., 121815) in the Size and Packed columns into clean, readable units (B, KB, MB, GB, TB).
  • ⚙️ Modular Settings: Toggle either tweak independently at any time in the mod's Settings tab.

🖼️ Previews

Human-Readable File Sizes

Smart Close on Esc

🛠️ How It Works

  • Modal & Input Guarding: Queries live Win32 thread GUI state (GetGUIThreadInfo) so Esc never interrupts active menu loops, drag/capture operations, dropdowns, or inline Edit rename boxes before sending WM_CLOSE.
  • In-Place ListView Formatting: Subclasses WinRAR's SysListView32 file list (both newly created and already-open windows) and formats raw byte counts on the fly as items are populated or refreshed.

⚠️ Compatibility & Notes

  • Refreshing After Changing Settings or Disabling: If you toggle the Human-Readable File Sizes setting on or off, or disable/remove the mod while WinRAR is open, please press F5 or navigate to another folder and back to refresh the file list with the updated size format.
  • Supported Column Languages: Out-of-the-box header detection supports English (Size, Packed) as well as common localized headers (Размер, Сжатый, Größe, Gepackt, Taille, Compressé, Tamaño, Comprimido).
  • Sorting Behavior: Because WinRAR sorts internal archive records prior to display formatting, sorting by Size or Packed continues to sort accurately by exact byte count.

🧩 More from this author

  • Drag to Scroll – Hold Ctrl + Right-Click and drag to scroll smoothly across desktop applications.
  • Explorer Custom Shortcuts – Customizable keyboard shortcuts for File Explorer: open terminal, copy paths, create files/folders, toggle hidden items, and launch apps with hotkeys.

entry.title: Bluetooth Auto Toggle 1.1.0
entry.content:
Bluetooth Auto Toggle

A Windhawk tool mod that automatically cycles Windows Bluetooth off and back on (in milliseconds) whenever Windhawk boots with your system and a connected Bluetooth device is detected.

Why this mod?

Some Bluetooth hardware adapters, drivers, and wireless peripherals (e.g., Bluetooth headphones, earbuds, mice, and keyboards) enter an unresponsive or degraded state on fresh system boots—even when Windows displays them as "connected"—causing audio silence, latency, or connection drops unless Bluetooth is power-cycled. This mod automates that process by waiting until a device is connected, pausing a configurable few seconds for the driver stack to settle, and cleanly cycling the Bluetooth radio off and then back on in the background.

Key Features

  • Device-Aware Activation: By default, only cycles Bluetooth when a connected Bluetooth device (headset, mouse, keyboard, etc.) is found.
  • Precise Millisecond Timing: Configurable startup delay, post-connection delay, and off-to-on toggle duration in milliseconds.
  • Dedicated Tool Mod Architecture: Runs in an isolated windhawk.exe background tool process without injecting into or hooking explorer.exe or any other critical system process.
  • Cold Boot Hardware Retry: Automatically retries radio enumeration if the Bluetooth service (bthserv) or adapter driver is still initializing during Windows boot.
  • State-Safe Cycling: Only toggles radios that are already powered ON (leaving radios in Airplane mode or turned off alone).
  • Safe Power Restoration: Minimizes the off window and ensures radios are commanded back on with retries even if the mod is unloaded mid-cycle.
  • Session-Safe: Remembers the current Windows logon session across tool process restarts using Windows Terminal Services (WTS) logon timestamps.
  • Graceful Lifecycle & Live Testing: Responsive to settings updates, mod reload, and instant cancellation on shutdown.

entry.title: Force Desktop Icon Spacing 1.1.6
entry.content:
Precisely control the desktop icon spacing: set the horizontal/vertical icon grid spacing and reserve a blank margin at the bottom of the icon area (above the taskbar).

How it works

  • The desktop list view (SysListView32) is subclassed (event-driven; the only polling is a one-time boot check that polls the icon count once a second for up to a minute after Explorer starts): every spacing request Explorer makes is transparently replaced with the configured values, and the icon area height is capped so it never enters the reserved bottom strip.
  • Values are absolute and applied in one pass: the same settings always produce the same layout, never cumulative drift.
  • The vertical grid is anchored at the top: increasing the vertical spacing stretches the grid downward, so the extra space is absorbed by the bottom region. No blank strip is created at the top, and the icon area is never shifted as a whole.
  • The bottom margin caps the icon area height only (the top edge stays fixed), so icon columns wrap earlier and never enter the reserved bottom strip.
  • All pixel values are scaled by the list view's DPI: the configured numbers apply at 100% scaling and scale up automatically on higher DPI.

Settings

  • Horizontal spacing (pixels): width of each icon grid cell, at 100% scaling. Larger = more horizontal gap between icons.
  • Vertical spacing (pixels): height of each icon grid cell, at 100% scaling. Larger = taller rows; the grid grows downward and the extra space is absorbed by the bottom region.
  • Bottom margin (pixels): blank strip reserved at the bottom of the icon area, above the taskbar, at 100% scaling. The icon grid never enters it. 0 = no reservation.
  • Rearrange icons on startup: arrange icons once when the mod loads and every time Explorer starts (sign-in, reboot, Explorer restart), so the spacing/margin take effect. Turn this off to keep icons where you place them by hand. Changes made in the settings always rearrange.

Notes

  • The grid cell size stays fixed when you change the icon size (Large/Medium/Small icons or Ctrl+wheel); adjust the spacing settings when you switch to Large icons, otherwise large icons may overlap their labels.
  • This mod doesn't write any registry values. If you want free icon placement, turn off "Auto arrange icons" and "Align icons to grid" in the desktop right-click menu yourself.
  • Disabling or unloading the mod restores the original icon spacing and the full icon area height. Icons stay where the mod arranged them (as with a manual "Arrange icons").
  • The bottom margin applies to the whole icon area (the list view spans all monitors); on multi-monitor setups it lands above the taskbar of the bottom-most monitor.

简体中文说明

精确控制桌面图标间距：自由调节图标网格的水平/垂直间距，并在图标区域底部（任务栏上方）预留空白边距。

工作原理

  • 通过子类化（事件驱动；唯一的轮询是资源管理器启动后长达一分钟、每秒一次的图标数量一次性开机检查）挂钩桌面列表视图（SysListView32）：资源管理器发出的每个间距设置请求都会被透明替换为配置值，图标区域高度被限制在预留边距之上。
  • 所有数值均为绝对值、一次性应用——同一配置永远得到同一布局，不存在多次叠加漂移。
  • 垂直网格顶端锚定：调大垂直间距时行距拉大、网格向下延伸，多余空间挤占底部区域——顶部不会产生空白，图标区域也不会被整体移动。
  • 底部边距只限制图标区域高度（顶边固定），图标换列提前，永不进入底部预留区。
  • 所有像素值按列表视图的 DPI 自动缩放：配置数值对应 100% 缩放，高 DPI 下自动放大。

设置项

  • 水平间距（像素）：图标网格单元宽度（100% 缩放下），数值越大图标水平间距越大。
  • 垂直间距（像素）：图标网格单元高度（100% 缩放下），数值越大行距越大，网格向下延伸，多余空间挤占底部区域。
  • 底部边距（像素）：图标区域底部（任务栏上方）预留的空白高度（100% 缩放下），图标网格不会进入该区域。0 = 不预留。
  • 启动时重排图标：模组加载时以及资源管理器每次启动时（登录、重启、重启资源管理器）各执行一次"排列图标"，使间距/边距生效。若希望保留手动拖放的图标布局，可关闭此项。在设置面板修改参数时始终会重排。

注意

  • 切换图标大小（大/中/小图标或 Ctrl+滚轮）时网格单元尺寸保持不变；切换到大图标时请相应调大间距设置，否则大图标可能与文字标签重叠。
  • 本模组不写入任何注册表值。如需自由摆放图标，请自行在桌面右键菜单中关闭"自动排列图标"和"将图标与网格对齐"。
  • 停用或卸载模组会自动恢复原始图标间距与图标区域完整高度；图标停留在重排后的位置（与手动"排列图标"一致）。
  • 底部边距作用于整个图标区域（列表视图横跨所有显示器）；多显示器下预留空白位于最底部显示器的任务栏上方。

entry.title: Language Switcher Position 1.3
entry.content:
Language Switcher Position

English

This mod allows you to customize the position of the modern Windows 11 26H2 input language switcher, which appears when clicking the language indicator (РУС / ENG) in the system tray.

Features

  • Left — positions the switcher at the left edge of the screen.
  • Center — positions the switcher in the center of the screen.
  • Right — positions the switcher at the right edge of the screen.
  • Custom X/Y — manually sets the window coordinates.
  • Vertical offset — provides additional vertical positioning control.

Screenshots

Settings

Horizontal position — selects the horizontal alignment: Left, Center, Right, or Custom X/Y.

Custom X coordinate — the horizontal window coordinate in pixels.

Custom Y coordinate — the vertical window coordinate in pixels.

Vertical offset — additional vertical displacement relative to the original Windows position. Used with Left, Center, and Right modes.

Compatibility

  • Windows 11 26H2
  • Windows Explorer (explorer.exe)
  • Modern XAML input language switcher.

Note

Positioning is calculated relative to the full monitor dimensions, including the taskbar area. Custom coordinates are specified in screen pixels.

The mod only changes the position of the switcher window and does not modify Windows input language settings.

Українська

Мод дозволяє змінювати положення сучасного перемикача мов введення Windows 11 26H2, який з'являється після натискання на індикатор мови (РУС / ENG) у системному треї.

Можливості

  • Left — розміщення перемикача біля лівого краю екрана.
  • Center — розміщення по центру екрана.
  • Right — розміщення біля правого краю екрана.
  • Custom X/Y — ручне налаштування координат вікна.
  • Vertical offset — додаткове вертикальне зміщення.

Налаштування

Horizontal position — вибір горизонтального розташування перемикача: Left, Center, Right або Custom X/Y.

Custom X coordinate — горизонтальна координата вікна в пікселях.

Custom Y coordinate — вертикальна координата вікна в пікселях.

Vertical offset — додаткове вертикальне зміщення відносно початкової позиції Windows. Використовується в режимах Left, Center та Right.

Сумісність

  • Windows 11 26H2
  • Windows Explorer (explorer.exe)
  • Сучасний XAML-перемикач мов введення.

Примітка

Позиціонування виконується відносно повного розміру монітора, включно з областю панелі завдань. Користувацькі координати задаються в екранних пікселях.

Мод змінює лише положення вікна перемикача та не впливає на системні налаштування мов введення.

entry.title: Siri Plus Launchpad 1.0.0
entry.content:
Siri Plus Launchpad

A Windhawk mod that replaces the Windows 11 Start menu with a macOS-inspired launcher: a Siri-style search bar with a categories menu, app tabs, file search, clipboard history, quick actions and live glass effects.

Press the Windows key (or click Start) and type, or pick what you want to search from the menu that drops down from the bar.

Highlights

  • Four modes: Original Siri (default), Floating, Window and Fullscreen
  • Live glass: real-time blur behind the bar and panels (animated wallpapers and videos keep playing underneath), plus an experimental liquid glass with refraction in the Siri modes
  • One search for everything: Apps, Files, Clipboard and Actions
  • App tabs: All, automatic categories and up to 6 tabs of your own
  • Recent apps row: recently opened or installed apps (or the most used ones) on top
  • Power options: type shut down, restart, sleep, lock or sign out, or use the floating power button
  • Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+1 … Ctrl+4 jump to Applications, Files, Actions and Clipboard, and can also open the launcher from any program (optional)
  • Custom icons: give any app your own icon (PNG, JPG, ICO, WebP…), or pick one from an icon gallery (any folder of icons, such as a downloaded icon pack), with search and a color filter
  • Themes: Clear glass, Light, Dark, OLED (deep black), Siri (macOS 27 gradient) and a fully Custom theme, with an optional glass effect on Light, Dark and OLED
  • Settings panel: the ⋯ button at the end of the bar opens every setting in a macOS-style panel, applied live
  • Move the bar: hold the Siri bar and drag it anywhere, on any monitor
  • Backup: save settings, folders, tabs and custom icons to one file and restore them, even after reinstalling
  • Your language: follows the Windows display language, or pick one (English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German and Italian)

Screenshots

Original Siri (default)

| Clear glass | Dark | OLED | |---|---|---| | | | |

Floating

| Clear glass | Light | Siri gradient | |---|---|---| | | | |

| Dark | OLED | |---|---| | | |

Window

| Clear glass | Light | Siri gradient | |---|---|---| | | | |

| Dark | OLED | |---|---| | | |

Fullscreen

| Clear glass | Light | Siri gradient | |---|---|---| | | | |

| Dark | OLED | |---|---| | | |

In action

| Settings panel | Moving the bar | |---|---| | | |

| Right-click menus and tabs | Power options | |---|---| | | |

Modes

Original Siri (default)

A search bar in the macOS 27 style.

  • Categories menu: hover over the bar (or click it) and a menu drops down with Applications, Files, Actions and Clipboard, each with its icon and its keyboard shortcut (default Ctrl+1 … Ctrl+4, configurable).
  • Picking a category makes its icon and name glide from the menu into the bar, and the search then works inside that category. If you type straight away, you go to Applications.
  • Going back: hover the category icon in the bar and it turns into a back arrow. Click it, or press Esc, to return to "Search" with the magnifier and pick another category.
  • App tabs:
  • All comes first and shows every app.
  • Then the automatic categories: Utilities, Productivity, Entertainment, Social, Creativity, Reading and Other.
  • Then up to 6 tabs of your own, for example "Games".
  • First row: recently opened or installed apps, or the most used ones (configurable), separated from the rest by a thin line.
  • Actions: Lock, Sleep, Restart, Shut down, Sign out, Settings, Task Manager, File Explorer, Control Panel, Screenshot and Empty Recycle Bin. Shut down works like Windows' own (fast startup when it is on) and warns before signing off other users who are still signed in.

Floating

The bar appears out of an animated circle, the Siri wave or a soft glow, with zoom and an adjustable bounce. Clicking it or typing slides the results panel down. When it closes, the bar is "sucked" back into the bubble.

Window and Fullscreen

The classic Launchpad grid with pages or vertical scrolling, folders and a power button. Pages always slide inside the glass. Fullscreen respects the work area and the space reserved by docks.

Managing app tabs (Original Siri)

| What | How | |---|---| | Create a tab | Right-click an app → New tab with this app, or right-click the tab strip / an empty area → New tab. Type the name and press Enter | | Add apps | Inside a tab, right-click → Add app. A picker shows every app: long-press the first one, then a simple click selects or deselects the others (selected apps jiggle); Done saves | | Remove an app | Inside a tab, right-click the app → Remove from tab | | Rename or delete | Right-click the tab → Rename tab / Delete tab | | Built-in tabs | They can also be edited (add or remove apps) and deleted. Restore default tabs brings them back | | Move through tabs | Tab / Shift+Tab, or click and drag the strip sideways (the mouse wheel works too) |

Files

  • Indexer: Everything (through IPC, no DLL needed), Windows Search or a direct scan. The default, Automatic, uses the first one that is available.
  • When the search is empty, your recent searches are shown, with a button to clear them. History can be turned off.
  • Results show the folder of each file under its name, in a list or as icons.
  • The maximum number of results is configurable.

Clipboard

  • Keeps the texts you copy while the mod runs (in memory only, never saved). The number of items and how long a copy stays (15 minutes to 7 days, or until Windows restarts) are configurable.
  • The category only shows up when there is something in it. Each item has an × to remove it, and right-clicking gives Clear clipboard, which empties the history and the Windows clipboard.
  • Passwords stay out: items that password managers and browsers mark as secret are skipped, just like Windows' own clipboard history (Win+V).
  • Shown as a list: the first line of each text, with a preview of the rest (or its size) underneath.
  • Click an item to copy it again. Turning the category off also stops monitoring and clears the history.

Apps and icons

  • Search apps by typing.
  • Folders (Window and Fullscreen): drag apps together, rename, undo. The Siri modes list the apps of every folder together.
  • Multi-select with jiggling icons, pin to taskbar (also by dragging an icon to the taskbar), uninstall.
  • Custom icons: right-click an app → Change icon… and pick an image (PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, ICO, GIF or WebP). The new icon is remembered across restarts; Reset icon brings back the original. Works in every mode, including apps inside folders.
  • Icon gallery: choose a folder of icon images in the settings (Apps and icons → Icon gallery folder, typed or picked with Choose…), for example a downloaded icon pack. Then right-click an app → Icon from gallery… The folder's images (subfolders included) show in the grid; type to search them by name, or use the color dots to see only one color or put them in rainbow order. Images added to the folder show up the next time the gallery opens. After picking, the launcher goes back to where it was, with that app selected.
  • Icon size, number of columns and the scrolling direction are configurable.

Settings panel

  • Click the ⋯ button at the end of the bar (every mode). The bar moves to the left and becomes a list of sections, and a panel with the settings comes out of the button. Every change applies at once.
  • Changes made there are kept on top of Windhawk's settings, and a change made later in Windhawk wins again.
  • Theme defaults (Appearance) brings back the chosen theme's own look. Restore all defaults (General) puts every setting back to how the mod comes and the bar back in the center; folders, tabs and custom icons stay.
  • Back up saves everything to a .siribackup file: every setting (the icon gallery folder too), folders, tabs, search history, the bar's place and the custom icons, with their pictures inside the file. Restore a backup brings it all back, also after uninstalling the mod (which erases its stored data) or on another PC.
  • In Window and Fullscreen the window folds into its search field while the settings are open. With the bar low on the screen, the settings open upward.

Moving the bar (Floating and Original Siri)

  • Hold the bar for a moment and drag it anywhere, on any monitor. Its place is remembered. Low on the screen, the results and menus open above it.
  • Right-click the bar → Put the bar back in the center (shown once it has been moved).

Customization

All options are in the ⋯ settings panel (in six languages) and in the mod's Settings tab in Windhawk (English and Portuguese).

| Block | Options | |---|---| | ① Mode | Original Siri (default), Floating, Window, Fullscreen | | ② Theme | Clear glass, Light, Dark, OLED, Siri (macOS 27 gradient), Custom | | Language | Automatic (Windows) or English, Português, Español, Français, Deutsch, Italiano | | ③ Appearance | Theme defaults button, glass transparency (each theme keeps its own; Light and OLED start solid), corner rounding, background blur (0 = no blur), blur behind right-click menus, text color (automatic: on clear glass, black over light backgrounds; or white or black), clear glass style (frosted, or experimental liquid for Floating and Original Siri, with its refraction strength and an optional live mode), glass effect on Light/Dark/OLED | | ④ Custom theme | Color, opacity, dark-to-light gradient, border width, color and opacity | | ⑤ Window and Fullscreen | Window size, search style (top bar or centered box), power button and its position, opening and closing animations (pop, fade, rise from/sink into the taskbar, CRT), animation speed, blur behind open folders | | ⑥ Floating and Original Siri | Bar size, results box width and rows for each category (Files and Clipboard as wide as the bar by default), circle animation (Siri wave, soft glow, none), circle zoom, bounce of the circle and of the results box, opening/closing duration, animation speed, power options when typing, floating power button, first row (recent, most used, off), Original Siri category shortcuts for Applications, Files, Actions and Clipboard (defaults Ctrl+1, Ctrl+2, Ctrl+3, Ctrl+4; any combination starting with Ctrl, e.g. Ctrl+Shift+F or Ctrl+F2), and whether they also work with the launcher closed (off by default) | | ⑦ Opening | Open with the Windows key and/or the Start button | | ⑧ Apps and icons | Icon size, columns, scrolling direction, jiggle, drag to the taskbar to pin, icon gallery folder | | ⑨ Files | On/off, search history, list or icons, indexer, maximum results | | ⑩ Clipboard | On/off, number of items kept, how long a copy stays |

Keyboard and mouse

| Key / action | What it does | |---|---| | Win / Start button | Open or close | | Type | Search (in Original Siri, typing right away searches Applications) | | Ctrl+1 / 2 / 3 / 4 | Original Siri: go to Applications / Files / Actions / Clipboard (configurable). With Also with the launcher closed on (off by default) they open the launcher from any program, and other programs no longer get those keys | | Tab / Shift+Tab | Original Siri: next/previous app tab, or move through the results in Files, Clipboard and Actions | | Arrows + Enter | Move through results / open | | Other Ctrl+digits | Launch the matching result (never an action such as Shut down) | | Esc | Closes menus, then clears the search, goes back to the categories and finally closes | | Right-click on the search bar | Cut, Copy, Paste, Select all, Delete all | | Long-press an app | Select it; then a simple click selects or deselects more apps (Window/Fullscreen: right-click → New folder with N items puts them in a folder; Original Siri: inside the app picker) |

Requirements

  • Windows 11 (x64)
  • Windhawk
  • Live blur needs Transparency effects turned on in Windows (Settings → Personalization → Colors). Without it, a blurred still image is used.
  • Optional: Everything for instant file search (run it normally, not as administrator)

Privacy and files

  • The mod never goes online.
  • Its own files (icons restored from a backup, the colors found for the gallery's images) are kept in the mod's storage folder, which Windhawk removes together with the mod. The gallery's images are only read from the folder you choose; backups are written only where you choose.
  • The clipboard history lives in memory only and is never written to disk.

Compatibility

  • Category shortcuts from any program (off by default): when Shortcuts → Also with the launcher closed is on, Ctrl+1 … Ctrl+4 are registered as system hotkeys, so other programs no longer get them (for example, the browser's Ctrl+1 for the first tab). Leave it off, or pick other combinations, if you need those keys elsewhere.
  • Fullscreen Start (fullscreen-start): don't enable both. Each one replaces the Start menu through the same hook without calling the original, so only one of them would get the Windows key.
  • Spotlight Launcher: it adds a separate search bar on Alt+Space and leaves the Start menu alone. This mod replaces the Start menu itself (Windows key and Start button) and adds app tabs, folders, files, clipboard history and actions. Both can be used together.

entry.title: Rounded Selection Rectangle 1.0
entry.content:
English

Gives the rectangle you draw to select files rounded corners and a gentle fade when you release the mouse. Works on the desktop, in File Explorer and in apps that use standard Windows list controls.

  • Adjust the corner roundness, border width and background opacity.
  • Choose background and border colors independently, or keep Windows default for either one.
  • Set the fade-out duration, or use 0 to turn it off. The mod respects the Windows animation setting.

In Background color and Border color, choose Custom color and enter a color such as #8B5CF6. Windows default ignores the custom value and follows the system color. Custom colors affect only the selection rectangle.

Compatible with Win32 UI Modernizer.

Other selection-rectangle mods, such as Desktop Marquee Fade and Classic Selection Rectangle Color, can overlap with this mod's fade or override its colors. Disable overlapping features if you use them together.

This mod depends on symbols published by Microsoft. If a Windows update has no published symbols, or changes the symbols the mod uses, the mod will stop working until compatible symbols or an updated mod are available.

Rounded selection in Home (WinUI)

File Explorer's Home page uses WinUI. To round its selection rectangle, install and enable Windows 11 File Explorer Styler in Windhawk. In that mod's settings, add an entry under Control styles and set Target to:

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Shapes.Rectangle#SelectionRectangle

Under Styles, add each of these four lines as a separate style:

Fill:=<SolidColorBrush Color="{ThemeResource SystemAccentColor}" Opacity="0.25" />
Stroke:=<SolidColorBrush Color="{ThemeResource SystemAccentColor}" />
RadiusX:=8
RadiusY:=8

Save the settings. This uses the Windows accent color, a 25% opacity fill and 8-unit corner radii. To change the roundness, adjust both RadiusX and RadiusY. These styles are configured separately from this mod's settings.

Português

Deixa o retângulo que você arrasta para selecionar arquivos com cantos arredondados e um desaparecimento suave ao soltar o mouse. Funciona na área de trabalho, no Explorador de Arquivos e em aplicativos com listas padrão do Windows.

  • Ajuste o arredondamento dos cantos, a espessura da borda e a opacidade do fundo.
  • Escolha as cores do fundo e da borda separadamente, ou mantenha o Padrão do Windows em cada uma.
  • Defina a duração do desaparecimento, ou use 0 para desativá-lo. O mod respeita a configuração de animações do Windows.

Em Cor do fundo e Cor da borda, escolha Cor personalizada e informe uma cor como #8B5CF6. Padrão do Windows ignora o valor personalizado e acompanha a cor do sistema. As cores personalizadas afetam somente o retângulo de seleção.

Compatível com o Win32 UI Modernizer.

Outros mods de retângulo de seleção, como Desktop Marquee Fade e Classic Selection Rectangle Color, podem sobrepor o fade ou as cores deste mod. Desative as funções equivalentes se usar esses mods juntos.

Este mod depende dos símbolos publicados pela Microsoft. Se uma atualização do Windows não tiver símbolos publicados, ou alterar os símbolos usados pelo mod, ele deixará de funcionar até que símbolos compatíveis ou uma atualização do mod estejam disponíveis.

Seleção arredondada na pasta Início (WinUI)

A pasta Início do Explorador de Arquivos usa WinUI. Para arredondar seu retângulo de seleção, instale e ative o Windows 11 File Explorer Styler no Windhawk. Nas configurações desse mod, adicione uma entrada em Control styles (estilos dos controles) e preencha Target (alvo) com:

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Shapes.Rectangle#SelectionRectangle

Em Styles (estilos), adicione cada uma destas quatro linhas como um estilo separado:

Fill:=<SolidColorBrush Color="{ThemeResource SystemAccentColor}" Opacity="0.25" />
Stroke:=<SolidColorBrush Color="{ThemeResource SystemAccentColor}" />
RadiusX:=8
RadiusY:=8

Salve as configurações. Isso usa a cor de destaque do Windows, fundo com 25% de opacidade e cantos de 8 unidades. Para mudar o arredondamento, ajuste RadiusX e RadiusY. Esses estilos são configurados separadamente das opções deste mod.

Español

Da esquinas redondeadas y un desvanecimiento suave al rectángulo que arrastras para seleccionar archivos. Funciona en el escritorio, en el Explorador de archivos y en aplicaciones con listas estándar de Windows.

  • Ajusta las esquinas, el grosor del borde y la opacidad del fondo.
  • Elige los colores de fondo y borde por separado, o conserva el Predeterminado de Windows para cada uno.
  • Ajusta la duración del desvanecimiento, o usa 0 para desactivarlo. El mod respeta la configuración de animaciones de Windows.

En Color de fondo y Color del borde, selecciona Color personalizado e introduce un color como #8B5CF6. Predeterminado de Windows ignora el valor personalizado y sigue el color del sistema. Los colores personalizados afectan sólo al rectángulo de selección.

Compatible con Win32 UI Modernizer.

Otros mods del rectángulo de selección, como Desktop Marquee Fade y Classic Selection Rectangle Color, pueden superponer el desvanecimiento o los colores. Desactiva las funciones equivalentes si usas esos mods juntos.

Este mod depende de los símbolos publicados por Microsoft. Si una actualización de Windows no tiene símbolos publicados, o cambia los símbolos que usa el mod, dejará de funcionar hasta que haya símbolos compatibles o una actualización del mod.

Selección redondeada en Inicio (WinUI)

La página Inicio del Explorador de archivos usa WinUI. Para redondear su rectángulo de selección, instala y activa Windows 11 File Explorer Styler en Windhawk. En los ajustes de ese mod, añade una entrada en Control styles (estilos de controles) e introduce lo siguiente en Target (destino):

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Shapes.Rectangle#SelectionRectangle

En Styles (estilos), añade cada una de estas cuatro líneas como un estilo separado:

Fill:=<SolidColorBrush Color="{ThemeResource SystemAccentColor}" Opacity="0.25" />
Stroke:=<SolidColorBrush Color="{ThemeResource SystemAccentColor}" />
RadiusX:=8
RadiusY:=8

Guarda los ajustes. Esto usa el color de énfasis de Windows, un fondo con un 25% de opacidad y esquinas de 8 unidades. Para cambiar el redondeado, ajusta RadiusX y RadiusY. Estos estilos se configuran por separado de las opciones de este mod.

entry.content:
Crazy Time

A minimalist scheduler for shutdown, sleep and hibernate, living in the notification area. Português abaixo.

This mod really shuts down, sleeps or hibernates your computer when a schedule fires. Save your work first. A warning notification appears before the action, and you can cancel or postpone an occurrence from the panel.

Windows 10 is untested. It was developed and tested on Windows 11 only. It is expected to work on Windows 10 (version 1809 or newer for the dark theme of the controls), but this has not been verified. Please report issues.

What it does

  • Schedule an action by duration (1 minute to 7 days), at a date and time, or repeating on chosen weekdays.
  • Keep several schedules at once: edit, pause, cancel one occurrence, postpone it by 10 minutes, or delete.
  • Countdown warnings at 30, 15, 10, 5 and 1 minute, with optional sound.
  • Schedules at the same instant are detected and refused.
  • Optional per-schedule "force apps to close" (shutdown only), off by default, with a data-loss warning.
  • Actions the computer cannot perform are explained instead of scheduled.
  • Portuguese and English; automatic, light or dark theme; high contrast.

How to use

  1. Enable the mod. A tray icon appears; click it to open the panel.
  2. Pick the action and how it is scheduled, then press Add schedule.
  3. Click the tray icon to open the panel again. Closing the panel keeps the countdown running; right-click the icon or use Options to exit. Exit stops scheduling until Windhawk restarts or the mod is toggled off and on again; Windhawk still lists the mod as enabled.
  4. Disabling the mod stops everything and removes the icon. Schedules are saved per user; occurrences that expired while the mod was off are not run.

Schedules are stored in Windhawk's mod storage, in a file named with your user SID. On first use, an existing legacy LocalAppData schedule file is copied there without overwriting an existing destination. The legacy file is kept as a backup. Removing the mod deletes Windhawk's managed storage; the legacy backup remains.

Português

Agendador minimalista de desligar, suspender e hibernar, na área de notificação.

Este mod realmente desliga, suspende ou hiberna o computador quando um agendamento dispara. Salve seu trabalho antes. Uma notificação de aviso aparece antes da ação e você pode cancelar ou adiar a ocorrência pelo painel.

Não testado no Windows 10. Desenvolvido e testado apenas no Windows 11. Deve funcionar no Windows 10 (versão 1809 ou mais nova para o tema escuro dos controles), mas isso não foi verificado. Relate problemas.

Como usar: ative o mod, escolha a ação e o tipo de agendamento (por duração, data e hora, ou repetição semanal) e clique em Adicionar agendamento. Clique no ícone da barra para reabrir o painel; fechar o painel não interrompe a contagem. Desativar o mod encerra tudo. Sair interrompe os agendamentos até reiniciar o Windhawk ou desativar e reativar o mod; ele ainda aparece como ativado no Windhawk.

entry.title: Nested Tray Drawer 0.1.13
entry.content:
Nested Tray Drawer

Add a second drawer to Windows 11's hidden notification-icons panel. Drag an icon onto the added chevron to collect it, then click the chevron to open the second drawer. Both drawers can remain visible together. Icons retain their native templates, input handlers and app context menus. The footer is 40 DIP high.

Concept illustration; example icons and panel styling are illustrative.

Experimental compatibility

Runtime validated on Windows 11 23H2 build 22631.5126 x64 with Windhawk 1.7.3, Taskbar.View.dll 2125.4507.10.0 and taskbar.dll from that installation. ARM64 builds and offline identity/symbol checks are also provided, using ARM64 taskbar.dll 10.0.26100.9549, SystemTray.dll 2608.26001.100.0 and Taskbar.View.dll 2125.26100.0.0. ARM64 UI behavior has not been tested on a physical device and remains experimental. Windows 10, other Windows builds, DPI/monitor combinations and interactions with other tray mods are unverified.

The mod discovers SystemTray.dll, older Taskbar.View.dll or ExplorerExtensions.dll and resolves the required internal interfaces and methods from symbols. It no longer requires a particular DLL version, timestamp, image size or vtable address. This does not make every Windows build supported: the symbol names, root layout and native identity ABI must still be compatible.

Persistent identity uses Wh_Disasm to follow a recognized interface-adjustment thunk and the HWND/UID/GUID copy on x64 or ARM64. Both constructor-based and inlined identity getters are recognized; the native owning-string return type is never called across C++ ABIs. Unrecognized symbols, instructions, field layouts or call targets are rejected rather than guessed. Some older ARM64 binaries (such as the inspected taskbar.dll 10.0.22621.3810) lack the required Identity() symbol. Do not bypass these checks to force compatibility.

Use

  1. Open the normal taskbar hidden-icons drawer.
  2. Drag an icon onto the added chevron and release it. Repeat to collect more.
  3. Click the added chevron to open or close the second drawer. Both drawers can remain open; an empty second drawer does not open.
  4. Right-click the chevron and choose Restore all collected icons to return every collected icon and explicitly clear saved membership.

There is no right-click icon picker or individual drag-out command. Disabling the mod using Windhawk's own toggle restores the native tray and preserves the saved collection. There is no second enable setting.

Saved collection

Records use Windhawk's public storage API, with a Windows-user SID suffix to separate users in installed Windhawk. Membership uses an app GUID, or the owning process's exact executable path and native UID. Missing apps keep their records; ambiguous or inaccessible identities remain visible. Changed app identifiers can require recollection. Records contain app identifiers/encoded paths, not secrets; the encoding is not encryption. No records are transmitted.

An invalid record is kept intact and icons remain visible. The chevron's context menu offers Reset saved collection for explicit recovery; a readable invalid API record is backed up before resetting. Uninstalling removes Windhawk-owned storage. Updates and Explorer restarts preserve the collection within the same mod ID.

Known limits

  • Custom app menus that do not expose foreground native menu state can dismiss both drawers after the bounded menu-start grace period.
  • Complete Explorer restart, full mouse/keyboard and drag-cancel coverage, light/high-contrast appearance and live theme switching remain untested.
  • Symbol discovery across module families is implemented; runtime compatibility on 24H2/25H2 is not established by the local build tests.

Credits

Native overflow access is adapted from m417z's GPLv3 Taskbar notification icon spacing. Symbol-based interface resolution and vtable verification follow Ris Peng's GPLv3 System Tray Folders. The Wh_Disasm instruction-scanning approach follows m417z's GPLv3 Taskbar height and icon size. Nested Tray Drawer keeps a separate simultaneous flyout and drag-based membership; it does not replace the first drawer with an in-grid folder view. The single-file mod retains its GPL-3.0 declaration.

entry.title: Task View Customizer 1.0.0
entry.content:
Task View Customizer

Customize Windows 11 Task View's layout and appearance using its existing virtual desktop thumbnails and window overview. Choose where the desktop list appears or show it without the window overview. Customize background materials, theme colors, desktop highlights and the New desktop button. Control hover switching, slide direction and scrolling speed while keeping the native controls.

Task View modes

  • Windows default: keeps desktops at the bottom while applying the mod's layout and appearance settings. This is the default mode.
  • Full Task View with desktops at the top: moves the desktop list above the window overview.
  • No Task View with Desktop list in the top: shows only the desktop list near the top of the screen.
  • No Task View with Desktop list at the center: shows only the desktop list, centered on the screen.
  • No Task View with Desktop list at the bottom: shows only the desktop list near the bottom.

The mod does not change Alt+Tab or the desktop preview shown when hovering over the taskbar's Task View button.

Screenshots

| Full Task View with Desktops list at the top | Desktop list at the center + Fit desktop tiles | Windows default + Fit desktop tiles | | :---: | :---: | :---: | | | | |

Settings

Task View behavior

Choose the mode, hide the New desktop button, or close Task View in any mode when the Windows key is released. In list-only modes, Tab navigates desktops and clicking outside the list closes it. Key-release closing requires holding Windows while using the list, then releasing it.

Desktop list layout

Choose full width, fit the desktop tiles, or set a percentage of the screen. Adjust the frame margin. Taskbar clearance follows the taskbar's actual edge and size on each monitor, including small/default taskbars and display scaling. Space already excluded by Windows is not counted twice. Windows default mode keeps desktops at the bottom while applying these sizing controls. Enable Prevent switching desktops on hover to suppress delayed mouse-hover selection of desktop thumbnails. Click a desktop to switch instead. The option applies to all Task View modes and leaves keyboard navigation available. Desktop hover switching delay (ms) sets the wait before that preview switches. The default is 400 ms, matching the current Windows mouse-hover delay read by Task View. Enter 0–600000; blank or invalid text preserves the native delay. Prevent switching desktops on hover takes priority over this setting.

New desktop button

The button follows the last desktop by default. Enable Move New desktop button to the right to keep it at the list's right edge while desktops scroll. Width, stretch, background and plus-sign alignment controls apply in both positions. Adjust the button width, hide its background, or position the plus sign. Stretch New desktop button to highlight height extends the button to match its hover/selection frame and hides the New desktop label. The width and plus-sign alignment settings still apply. Turn the toggle off to restore the original vertical layout. Stretching also applies to Windows default mode through the shared button layout.

Background materials

Choose Native, Solid color, Acrylic, Clear, or experimental Mica. Solid starts opaque and can be made translucent without blur. Acrylic uses a live blurred backdrop and tint. Clear removes the material. You can also hide the list background in list-only modes or remove its outer border without removing desktop selection borders.

Material transparency accepts 0-100. Zero keeps the material's default strength; 100 makes Native, Solid and Acrylic backgrounds clear. Values outside that range use default strength; -1 is the default setting. Thumbnails and labels remain visible, and native hover/focus brush alpha is preserved rather than turning faint highlights opaque.

Mica uses a panel-local blurred wallpaper brush with color and luminosity blends. Its transparency control reduces tint/luminosity while keeping the wallpaper layer opaque. This is an experimental approximation of the native window material: its appearance can differ from apps using Windows' DWM Mica backdrop. It falls back to a solid color when unavailable. Windows can also use Acrylic's solid fallback when transparency is disabled. Hiding the desktop list background takes priority over material styling.

Desktop highlights

Keep Windows' highlight or choose border only, background only, or both. The highlight background opacity controls the hovered/selected desktop fill.

Theme colors

Set background and border colors independently for dark and light mode. Accepts native, accent, #RRGGBB, or #AARRGGBB. accent follows the current Windows accent color; invalid values preserve native colors. Background colors also provide Acrylic/Mica tint and custom highlight fill. Border colors apply to panel borders and custom highlights.

Full-screen backdrop

Keep the native backdrop, clear it, or use Acrylic with adjustable dimming. The list-only disable-blur option keeps the wallpaper clear even when Windows transparency is enabled. It is independent of the desktop strip's background. An explicit backdrop choice overrides the disable-blur option.

Animations and scrolling

Choose Desktop list animation direction: From the bottom (default) or From the top, independently of Task View mode. This controls entrance and exit motion. Disable Task View animations independently of the background material. Adjust desktop reveal scrolling speed from 10-500%: 100% uses Windows' current speed, 50% is half speed, and 200% is double speed.

Compatibility

Designed for Windows 11. Windows builds can change Task View's internal control names and layout; unrecognized controls are left alone. Mica remains experimental. Mixed-DPI monitors, desktop drag and drop, and interactions with other shell customization mods can depend on the Windows build.

No PDB debugging symbols or byte-pattern scanning are required. Desktop-slide direction uses public animation properties and live layout geometry; unrecognized or ambiguous slides are left unchanged.

entry.title: Brave Acrylic 3.9
entry.content:
Brave Acrylic

Very important — Symbol cache: Controlled and maintained by bardelyne, the author of Brave Acrylic. This is an author-hosted cache, not an official Windhawk service. Our GitHub Actions workflow checks for new Brave releases and prepares small compatibility files from Brave’s official symbols. Windhawk downloads the matching file for your installed Brave build and caches it locally. The large symbol files are processed by the workflow; your PC receives only the small compatibility data.

Reveal the Windows backdrop through Brave's vertical tab area, frame, toolbar, address field, and webpage area. Add rounded acrylic menus and native popups, plus blur behind address-bar suggestions. Native background targeting works across theme colors. Use a website-styling extension for backgrounds painted by websites.

Alpha software. Translucent Windows is required, configured for brave.exe. Brave Acrylic exposes the background; Translucent Windows supplies the effect.

Restart Brave after applying the mod, updating it, or changing its settings. Close all Brave windows normally and exit any remaining background Brave instance, then reopen it. This rebuilds native windows and their cached backgrounds.

Requirements

  • x64 version of Brave.
  • Windhawk with Brave Acrylic enabled.
  • Translucent Windows configured to apply a translucent effect to brave.exe.
  • Windows Transparency effects enabled.

Compatibility

Windows 11 is the tested environment. Windows 10 is unverified; the backdrop provider and selected effect must support that Windows version. Native ARM64 Brave is unsupported.

The native-popup suggestion method was tested with Brave 1.98.60 and with regular Brave 1.98.62 / Chromium 156, including YouTube with Zen Internet transparency enabled. The current native contract is validated separately against those two official DLL/PDB pairs. Other builds need valid compatibility data for their exact chrome.dll. Native interfaces and rendering behavior can change and may require a mod update.

The earlier background-only native contract was validated on seven official releases from Brave 1.93.138 through 1.98.62 (Chromium 151–156). This checks the native compatibility data; it is separate from visual testing. See the compiler study.

Fast setup

  1. Enable Translucent Windows for brave.exe and choose the desired backdrop.
  2. Enable Brave Acrylic. Leave Vertical tabs background, Toolbar, and Webpage background on.
  3. Close all Brave windows normally and reopen Brave. Exit its background instance too if it stays running.
  4. Optionally use Zen Internet or Stylus to remove backgrounds inside websites, as explained below. Stylus requires custom CSS.

No theme-color setup is required.

Controls

| Setting | Default | Purpose | | --- | --- | --- | | Vertical tabs background | On | Reveal the backdrop behind the vertical tab area and browser frame. | | Toolbar | On | Clear the toolbar, bookmarks bar, and unfocused address-field backgrounds. Focused address fields keep their native theme. | | Webpage background | On | Clear only Chromium's background behind the webpage area, including its default white fallback. Website HTML, CSS, and content are unchanged. Use Zen Internet or Stylus for website backgrounds; Stylus requires custom CSS. | | Acrylic menus | On | Blur native context menus, the main menu, and submenus. Text, icons, selection, and input stay native. | | Acrylic popups | On | Blur supported native browser bubbles and the native Extensions manager. Extension and website HTML overlays keep their own styling. | | Blur search suggestions | On | Use a native results popup with Windows blur below the input cutout. Typed text, result text and input remain native and sharp. | | Hide duplicate Windows buttons | Off | Optional workaround that removes the real Windows system-menu style. It can affect Alt+Space, taskbar menus and other window tools. Prefer Brave's Use compact mode option in Appearance. | | Use online symbol cache | On | Let Windhawk download small exact-build files from the author-controlled cache. Turn off to use existing local cached symbols only, then restart Brave. |

Restart Brave after applying settings, even when a change appears immediately. Some backing views and native popup choices are created with their windows. Webpage backing can apply on tab selection without refreshing the page; restarting after disabling it restores existing renderer defaults. The caption-button option can apply immediately.

Website backgrounds with extensions

Webpage background clears only Chromium's backing layer underneath websites, including the default white fallback. It does not modify website HTML, CSS, or content. To remove backgrounds painted by a website, use a styling extension such as Zen Internet or Stylus.

Zen Internet

For backgrounds inside websites, install Zen Internet from the Chrome Web Store. Open the extension, go to Advanced Settings, and turn Disable Transparency off under Global Feature Controls. Keep Webpage background enabled in Brave Acrylic. Open a new tab or reload an existing page to apply extension setting changes.

Zen Internet applies website-specific styles; coverage and results vary by site. Brave Acrylic removes the browser's backing and white fallback so CSS-transparent page areas can reveal the Windows backdrop. The extension handles website styling. Brave Acrylic does not inject JavaScript or CSS into pages.

The extension's store page cautions that ordinary Chromium does not support transparent pages. Brave Acrylic provides the native transparency path; an extension alone cannot provide the Windows effect. The extension's source and website styles are available separately.

Stylus

Stylus from the Chrome Web Store lets you create and manage custom CSS styles for individual websites. It does not remove website backgrounds out of the box. You must write or paste CSS rules that make the desired backgrounds transparent, or install a suitable existing userstyle. Complex websites may need rules for several background elements. Keep Webpage background enabled in Brave Acrylic so those transparent areas reveal the backdrop.

See the Stylus guide to writing styles for creating a style and limiting it to a particular website.

How it works

Brave's existing transparent-host path enables its compositor to preserve transparency. The mod removes the actual vertical-tab backing through Brave's own setter and clears selected native background roles within their paint clip. Child controls and text retain their original painting. Native focus checks preserve the focused address field.

The webpage option clears the native backing during content-view updates and sets Chromium's persistent page-base color when a tab is attached. That value is also used by future renderers, so switching or restoring tabs does not bring the default white background back. Explicit website backgrounds remain visible unless a website-styling extension changes them.

The full native path uses 29 functions, of which 20 are private hooks, and one immutable background-class vtable. Each feature has its own dependency set; unavailable features keep their native appearance. The implementation uses no sampled colors, private object-member offsets, guessed screen rectangles, screenshot polling, input forwarding, or GPU hooks. Normal DirectComposition stays enabled, with no special browser launch flag. Windows supplies the backdrop. Acrylic can turn gray when inactive; choose a suitable blur mode in Translucent Windows for the main window if you prefer a persistent effect.

Menus, popups and suggestions

Native menus and bubbles keep their own theme colors with reduced background alpha. A Windows host-backdrop visual sits underneath Chromium in the same popup window and follows its actual rounded background geometry. There are no extra overlay windows or input forwarding. A private composition worker owns its own dispatcher; disabling the mod closes its targets and joins that worker without changing Brave's dispatcher. If Windows cannot read the host-backdrop capability flag, cleanup removes the visual effect without guessing a prior flag value.

Tab and group hover cards, including their fading text and memory icons, keep their foreground painting. Their separate client and footer backgrounds are removed, while a tint derived from Brave’s own background color sits beneath Chromium’s content. This keeps the tint consistent during transitions and avoids black fade masks. The same native-popup path covers dialogs such as Restore pages?. Windows-drawn popup borders are suppressed where supported and their previous value is restored on unload.

The native Extensions manager also clears its repeated scroll-container backgrounds so they cannot cover the blur. Extension names, icons, pin buttons, menus and the Manage extensions button keep their native painting and input. This does not alter HTML content inside an extension's own popup.

Suggestions use Chromium's normal desktop-popup factory instead of its in-window Aura override. Windows supplies the blur behind that native results popup, which also works with the tested Zen Internet transparency setup. Chromium still owns its contents, layout, keyboard navigation and mouse input. Native view bounds and header height define a rounded window region below the address field; there is no input catcher or separate overlay. Resizing and DPI changes update the region, and cleanup restores the actual prior region on the owning UI thread. Restart Brave after applying this option so existing results widgets are rebuilt. These options do not turn website dialogs or extension HTML into acrylic. Windows high contrast and transparency preferences are cached and updated from Windows notifications off Brave’s paint path.

Symbol resolution, privacy and updates

Brave Acrylic resolves exact C++ prototypes and the background-class identity with Windhawk's supported HookSymbols / WH_HOOK_SYMBOLS_OPTIONS::onlineCacheUrl mechanism. Windhawk handles its ordinary local cache and optional online download. No build-specific addresses are embedded and remote PDB downloads remain disabled. The mod retains local executable-range, unwind-boundary, approved-leaf, thunk and overlap checks before registering hooks.

Small named-symbol files are published under brave-acrylic-features-v7/ on our symbol-cache branch. They contain the native function locations needed for each Brave build. The service and publishing workflow are controlled and maintained by bardelyne.

Windhawk handles compatibility downloads and local caching through its standard mechanism. Our workflow uses pinned actions and checks the official Brave archive and matching symbols before publishing. See cache hosting for the technical details.

No telemetry, uploads or login: the mod only downloads compatibility data through Windhawk. Browser cookies, history, page content, settings and account details stay on your PC. Turn Use online symbol cache off and restart Brave to use suitable existing local cached symbols only.

The workflow requests a check every two hours, with a backup 30 minutes later. GitHub can delay or drop scheduled starts, so this is not an exact timer. It checks the stable release, asset identities and native contract before downloading large files. Unchanged releases skip browser and PDB downloads. Both generation and publication use the run's same source revision; large official files stay on the GitHub runner. Restart Brave after newly required compatibility data becomes available.

The extractor handles verified compiler folding according to each function's role, while rejecting unrelated sharing on patched functions. The workflow reports compatibility separately for vertical tabs, the toolbar, webpage backing, menus, popups, and suggestions. A missing or changed function disables only its dependent features. Validated features are still published, and the workflow summary lists unavailable features with their reasons. Invalid files, mismatched symbols, failed downloads, and publishing errors still stop publication.

Duplicate corner buttons

If two sets of minimize/maximize/close buttons appear, first enable Use compact mode in Brave Settings → Appearance. The optional Hide duplicate Windows buttons workaround is off on a fresh install because it removes the window's actual WS_SYSMENU style. Windows system menus, taskbar interactions, accessibility tools or other window managers may be affected. Disabling the option or unloading the mod restores its recorded style changes.

Troubleshooting

Restart Brave after installing or applying changes: close all windows and its background instance, then reopen normally. Enable Windhawk debug logging to check each feature's availability or a symbol-cache message. For website styling, check Zen Internet's transparency setting and whether that site has a supported style, or check the CSS and site scope of your Stylus style.

For reports, include Windows/Brave versions, window type, enabled areas, backdrop configuration, and reproduction steps. See the advanced reference, compatibility data, webview investigation, and changelog.
